public.hero.intro: Mecropolis iteranya iminsi y’ubushyuhe bwo gukura (GDD) ikoresheje ubushyuhe Open-Meteo yanditse kuva igihingwa gitewe. Iyo igiteranyo kirenze urugero rw’igihingwa, igihembwe cyo muri Western Cape kijya ku cyiciro gikurikira.

public.how.title: Kuva ku itariki yo gutera kugeza ku cyiciro
public.how.lead: Ubusanzwe icyiciro cyandikwa n’umuntu, kikaba kigezweho gusa kugeza ku ivugurura rya nyuma. Hano kibarwa hakurikijwe ikirere cyanditswe, kandi buri mpinduka ibikwa n’ibimenyetso byayo.
public.step.1.title: Andika ibyo umuhinzi azi
public.step.1.body: Imirima, ibibanza, ibihingwa n’amatariki yo gutera bibikwa muri Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Zana amakuru y’ikirere cyabaye
public.step.2.body: Ubushyuhe bwa buri munsi bw’aho ikibanza kiri buva mu bubiko bwa Open-Meteo, kuva ku itariki yo gutera kugeza uyu munsi.
public.step.3.title: Teranya iminsi y’ubushyuhe
public.step.3.body: Iminsi y’ubushyuhe bwo gukura (GDD) iteranywa hakurikijwe imibare y’igihingwa. Iyo irenze urugero, sisitemu yimurira igihembwe ku cyiciro gikurikira kandi ikandika icyabishingiweho.

public.models.lead: Iminsi y’ubushyuhe ikenewe ngo igihingwa cyere. Ibi bipimo byanditswe n’abantu kandi nta nkomoko biragira.
public.live.title: Uko ikirere kimeze ku murima w’igerageza wa Swartland
public.live.lead: Ibipimo biva ahantu rusange, bikavugururwa buri minota 30.
public.yields.title: Ibipimo by’umusaruro byatangajwe
public.honesty.title: Uko amakuru akoreshwa
public.honesty.1.title: Umusaruro wandikwa n’ushinzwe sisitemu
public.honesty.1.body: Kugeza igihe ushinzwe umurima yanditse umusaruro, porogaramu yerekana “Ntiwanditswe”.
public.honesty.2.title: Imibare fatizo ibikwa ukwawo
public.honesty.2.body: Imibare y'uturere n'igihugu ibikwa mu nyandiko zayo, hamwe n'aho yavuye n'igipimo. Ntigereranywa n'umusaruro w'umurima.
public.honesty.3.title: Amakuru y'udukoko ni ay'akarere
public.honesty.3.body: GBIF yerekana aho udukoko twabonetse mu ntera ya 100 km, ikanerekana intera.
public.honesty.4.title: Ikirere kigaragazwa ako kanya
public.honesty.4.body: Ubushyuhe buvanwa mu bubiko bwa Open-Meteo igihe busabwe.

public.open.body: Injira muri demo urebe umurongo wa GDD w'igihembwe n'ibimenyetso byakoreshejwe kumenya icyiciro kirimo.

public.about.title: Ibyerekeye
public.about.heading: Ibyerekeye Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ni porogaramu ikurikirana imirima n'ibihingwa byo mu murima wo muri Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Impamvu yakozwe
public.about.why.body: Ibyiciro by'ibihingwa ntibivugururwa, kandi umusaruro wandikwa bibukijwe. Mecropolis ibara icyiciro ikoresheje amakuru y'ikirere yabitswe. Buri mubare utangwa n'ushinzwe umurima cyangwa ukava ahantu hazwi kandi hafunguye.
public.about.design.title: Uko yakozwe
public.about.design.1.body: Growing degree days ziteranywa kuva ku itariki yo gutera, hakoreshejwe ububiko bwa Open-Meteo. Iyo icyiciro gihindutse, ibimenyetso byabyo birabikwa: itariki cyatangiriyeho, igiteranyo cya GDD n'amakuru cyabazweho.
public.about.design.2.body: Icyiciro gikurikira icyo kwitegura gusarura cyitwa kwera bitewe n'ubushyuhe, kuko nta gikorwa cyo gusarura cyanditswe.
public.about.design.4.body: Ibikwa mu nyandiko zayo, hamwe n'aho yavuye, igipimo n'uruhushya rwo kuyikoresha.
public.about.stack.title: Ikoranabuhanga
public.about.stack.body: Ni porogaramu y'urupapuro rumwe ya Vite na React 19 iri kuri Cloudflare Pages. Mucukumbuzi isoma amakuru rusange ya Sanity ako kanya ikoresheje GROQ n'ikurikiranamakuru ry'ako kanya. Kwandika no kubona amakuru arinzwe bikorwa na Cloudflare Pages Functions, igenzura cookie y'icyiciro yashyizweho umukono. Zod igenzura amakuru yinjira n'asohoka, Vitest ikoreshwa mu igerageza, naho Tailwind 4 igatunganya imigaragarire.
public.about.limits.title: Ibyo itarashobora
public.about.limits.1: Imibare ikoreshwa mu gukurikirana igihingwa (ubushyuhe fatizo, ubushyuhe bukenewe ngo kimere no ngo cyere) yanditswe n'intoki kandi nta masoko iragira.
public.about.limits.2: Imibare fatizo ya lupin iva muri HarvestStat yo kuva 2000 kugeza 2007 gusa, kandi gutangiza amakuru ntibyabonye inyandiko z'imibare fatizo ya lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Amakuru y'udukoko ni inyandiko za GBIF z'aho twabonetse hafi y'umurima. Yerekana aho ubwoko bwabonetse hafi y'umurima.
public.about.limits.4: Demo ifite konti imwe ihuriweho n'abayikoresha bose, kandi igabanya ubwinshi bw'ibisabwa ikoresheje ububiko bw'igihe gito. Kwinjira bihisha amapaji y'igenzura ariko ntibirinda amakuru, kuko buri wese ashobora kuyasoma. Ariko birinda buri cyandikwa.

docs.stages.title: Uko ibyiciro bikurikirana
docs.stages.guards: Buri kwimuka mu cyiciro kugenzurwa. Icyiciro cyo guterwa gisaba itariki yo gutera n'igihingwa; gukura bisaba igipimo cya degree days cyo kumera; kwitegura gusarura bisaba 90% by'igipimo cyo kwera; kwera bitewe n'ubushyuhe bisaba ko igipimo cyo kwera cyagezweho; gusuzuma bisaba incamake y'ikirere cy'igihembwe n'imibare fatizo yemejwe. Igenzura rya GDD risaba kandi amakuru y'ubushyuhe yibura kuri 90% by'igihe, kandi kwimuka gufite itariki yo gutangira iri imbere ntikwemerwa.

guide.title: Uko wakoresha Mecropolis
guide.lead: Amabwiriza magufi kandi yoroshye. Asobanura icyo porogaramu igenewe, abayikoresha n'icyo buri gice gikora.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ni iki?
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ikurikirana imirima n'ibihingwa. Imenya aho igihingwa kigeze ikurikije ubushyuhe cyabonye kuva gitewe, kandi ikwereka hamwe ikirere, ubutaka n'udukoko biri hafi y'umurima wawe.
guide.what.p2: Yakorewe imirima yo muri Western Cape muri Afurika y'Epfo, ariko ishobora gukoreshwa ku murima uwo ari wo wose, mu karere ako ari ko kose no mu gihembwe icyo ari cyo cyose.
guide.who.title: Abayigenewe
guide.who.p1: Igenewe uwita ku mirima, nk'umuhinzi, umuyobozi w'umurima cyangwa umujyanama wabo.
guide.who.p2: Ntukeneye kumenya iby'ikoranabuhanga cyangwa ubumenyi bw'ikirere. Niba ushobora gufungura urubuga, ushobora gukoresha Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Impamvu wayikoresha
guide.why.1: Uhita ubona ibihingwa bikimara guterwa, ibiri gukura n'ibiri hafi kwera.
guide.why.2: Ntugomba kuvugurura buri murima n'intoki, kuko porogaramu yimura igihingwa mu cyiciro gikurikira iyo amakuru y'ikirere agaragaje ko igihe kigeze.
guide.why.3: Ikuburira ku bukonje bukabije n'ubushyuhe bwinshi biteganyijwe mu minsi iri imbere, no ku dukoko twagaragaye hafi y'umurima wawe.
guide.why.4: Ibyanditswe byose ku murima, nk'umuti watewe, agakoko wabonye cyangwa inyandiko, bibikwa hamwe n'itariki yabyo kugira ngo uzabisubiremo nyuma.
guide.why.5: Buri mubare werekana aho wavuye, kugira ngo umenye uwo wakwizera.
guide.heat.title: Uko porogaramu imenya aho igihingwa kigeze
guide.heat.p1: Ibihingwa bikura vuba iyo hashyushye, bigakura buhoro iyo hakonje. Buri munsi Mecropolis ibara ubwo bushyuhe nk'ibipimo by'ubushyuhe, abahanga bita growing degree days cyangwa GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Buri munsi ifata impuzandengo y'ubushyuhe bwo hejuru n'ubwo hasi, igakuramo ubushyuhe igihingwa kidakuriraho. Igisigaye ni ibipimo by'ubushyuhe by'uwo munsi. Umunsi ukonje nta cyo wongeraho.
guide.heat.p3: Buri gihingwa gikenera igiteranyo runaka cy'ibipimo by'ubushyuhe kugira ngo cyere. Uko igiteranyo kuva gitewe cyegera uwo mubare, ni ko igihingwa kijya mu cyiciro gikurikira.
guide.heat.p4: Ubushyuhe buva kuri Open-Meteo, serivisi y'ubuntu ibika amakuru y'ikirere ya buri hantu ku isi.
guide.stages.title: Ibyiciro bitandatu
guide.stages.intro: Buri gihingwa muri buri murima kinyura muri ibi byiciro bikurikirana.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Igihingwa kimaze kubona hafi y'ubushyuhe bwose gikeneye, bityo igihe cyo kwitegura gusarura kirageze.
guide.stages.harvested: Igihingwa kimaze kubona ubushyuhe bwose gikeneye, bityo kigomba kuba cyeze. Ni wowe gusa wemeza niba cyarasaruwe koko, ni yo mpamvu porogaramu ibyita kwera bitewe n'ubushyuhe.
guide.stages.review: Igihembwe kirarangiye, ushobora kureba uko cyagenze.
guide.stages.p2: Porogaramu igenzura buri gihingwa buri joro n'igihe cyose umuntu yongeyemo ibyo yabonye cyangwa igikorwa yakoze. Ushobora no gukanda Reconcile now ku gihembwe kugira ngo ihite igenzura.
guide.start.title: Gutangira
guide.start.1: Fungura ipaji ibanza. Ushobora kubona ikarita y'ikirere, ubutaka, udukoko n'umusaruro by'umurima w'icyitegererezo utinjiye muri konti.
guide.start.2: Kanda Sign in hejuru, ukoreshe amakuru ya konti y'icyitegererezo wahawe.
guide.start.3: Hitamo umurima. Hahita hafunguka incamake y'uwo murima.
guide.start.4: Kanda ku gihembwe urebe amakuru yose y'icyo gihingwa muri uwo murima.
guide.start.5: Koresha ahatoranyirizwa ururimi hejuru ya buri paji kugira ngo uhindure ururimi. Porogaramu izibuka iryo wahisemo ubutaha.
guide.home.title: Ipaji ibanza
guide.home.p1: Ipaji ibanza yerekana ikarita y'akarere ifite amabara ajyanye n'ubushyuhe ubutaka bwabonye muri iki gihembwe. Yerekana kandi ikirere cy'ubu n'icy'iminsi iri imbere, ubutaka bw'umurima w'icyitegererezo, udukoko duherutse kugaragara hafi n'impuzandengo y'umusaruro w'akarere. Ntukeneye kwinjira muri konti ngo ubibone.
guide.dashboard.title: Incamake y'umurima
guide.dashboard.intro: Iyi ncamake yerekana umurima umwe. Ibi ni ibice byayo kuva hejuru kugera hasi. Agasanduku k'umurima kari hejuru kagufasha kujya ku wundi murima.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Incamake y'umurima
guide.dashboard.summary: Umubare w'imirima n'ubuso bwayo muri hegitari, ibihembwe biri gukorwa n'ibihingwa byeze.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Ibikeneye kwitabwaho
guide.dashboard.alerts: Imiburo migufi, nk'ubukonje bukabije cyangwa ubushyuhe bwinshi biteganyijwe, igihingwa cyeze, igihembwe kitangiriye igihe cyangwa udukoko twagaragaye hafi y'umurima. Buri muburo uvuga icyawuteye.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Imiterere y'umurima
guide.dashboard.conditions: Ikirere cy'uyu munsi, iteganyagihe, ubutaka n'udukoko biri hafi y'uyu murima.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Aho igihembwe kigeze
guide.dashboard.progress: Agakarita ka buri gihingwa kerekana ubushyuhe kimaze kubona. Ushobora kugereranya imirima no gukuramo urutonde nka dosiye y'urupapuro rw'imibare (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Imirima
guide.dashboard.fields: Buri murima n'ubuso bwawo, ubutaka bwawo n'ibihingwa biwurimo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Shakisha amakuru
guide.dashboard.search: Andika mu magambo asanzwe icyo ushaka, nko kuvuga inda ku ngano. Ishaka ibyo wabonye n'ibikorwa bifite igisobanuro kimwe, nubwo byanditswe mu yandi magambo.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Inama
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Imirimo isabwa gukorwa mu murima, nko gutera umuti cyangwa gushyiramo ifumbire. Ushobora kwemera cyangwa kwanga buri nama, ukayishyiraho ko yarangiye iyo umurimo urangiye.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ibyakozwe vuba
guide.dashboard.activity: Urutonde rw'igihe buri gihingwa cyimukiye mu cyiciro gishya.
guide.season.title: Ipaji y'igihembwe
guide.season.intro: Igihembwe ni igihingwa kimwe kiri mu murima umwe mu mwaka umwe. Ipaji yacyo igaragaza amakuru yacyo yose.
guide.season.top.label: Hejuru ya paji
guide.season.top: Igihingwa, umurima, itariki yo gutera, igihe giteganyijwe cyo gusarura n'umusaruro umaze kuwushyiramo.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ibyiciro by'igihingwa
guide.season.pipeline: Ibyiciro bitandatu, icy'ubu kikagaragazwa. Kanda Reconcile now kugira ngo uhite ugenzura niba igihingwa kigomba kujya mu kindi cyiciro.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ibyiteguye gufatirwaho icyemezo
guide.season.readiness: Urutonde rw'ibyo porogaramu ikenera mbere yo kwimura igihingwa, nk'itariki yo gutera n'amakuru y'ikirere ahagije. Buri kintu cyanditseho Pass, Warning cyangwa Blocked; ikiri Blocked kikakubwira ikibura.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ibimenyetso
guide.season.evidence: Amakuru porogaramu yakoresheje ifata ibyemezo, kugira ngo uyagenzure.
guide.season.propose.label: Tanga inama
guide.season.propose: Tanga igitekerezo cy'umurimo wo gukora muri uyu murima, wongereho ibimenyetso by'igihembwe. Kiguma ari inyandiko y'agateganyo kugeza umuntu acyemeje ku ncamake y'umurima.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Igishushanyo cy'ibipimo by'ubushyuhe byiyongera kuva igihingwa gitewe, n'umurongo werekana igiteranyo gikeneye.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Byagenda bite?
guide.season.whatIf: Gerageza itariki yo gutera ibanziriza cyangwa ikurikira iyari isanzwe, cyangwa igihembwe gishyushye cyangwa gikonje kurushaho, urebe uko ibipimo by'ubushyuhe byahinduka. Nta kibikwa.
guide.season.summary.label: Incamake y'igihembwe
guide.season.summary: Incamake ngufi y'amakuru y'igihembwe yanditswe na AI. Yifashishe gusa, kandi ugenzure amakuru niba hari ikigaragara nabi.
guide.season.notes.label: Inyandiko z'igihembwe
guide.season.notes: Inyandiko z'igihembwe zifite amatariki. Ushobora kuzongeramo, kuzihindura no kuzisiba, cyangwa kugarura inyandiko ya kera.
guide.season.files.label: Ifoto y'umurima na raporo y'ipimwa ry'ubutaka
guide.season.files: Ohereza ifoto y'umurima na PDF ya raporo y'ipimwa ry'ubutaka yavuye muri laboratwari.
guide.season.log.label: Ibyanditswe ku murima
guide.season.log: Ibyo wabonye mu murima n'ibyo wawukoreye, nko gutera umuti wanditseho izina ryawo n'ingano yakoreshejwe.
guide.season.history.label: Amateka y'ibyahinduwe
guide.season.history: Buri cyahinduwe kuri iki gihembwe kikabikwa, hamwe n'itariki yacyo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Ikigereranyo cy'akarere
guide.season.benchmark: Impuzandengo y'umusaruro w'akarere ivuye mu mibare rusange. Ikoreshwa mu kugereranya gusa, si umusaruro w'umurima wawe.
guide.season.pests.label: Udukoko twagaragaye mu karere
guide.season.pests: Udukoko twatangajwe hafi y'umurima kuri GBIF, ububiko rusange bw'ibyagaragaye. Kanda Fetch sightings kugira ngo ubone ibishya.
guide.sources.title: Aho imibare iva
guide.sources.weather: Amakuru y'ikirere ava kuri Open-Meteo, yaba ay'uyu munsi, iteganyagihe n'ay'iminsi yashize.
guide.sources.soil: Amakuru y'ubutaka ava kuri SoilGrids, ikarita y'ubutaka bw'isi.
guide.sources.pests: Amakuru y'udukoko twagaragaye ava kuri GBIF, ububiko rusange bw'ibyagaragaye.
guide.sources.yields: Umusaruro w'akarere uva kuri USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa na Banki y'Isi.
guide.sources.you: Andi makuru yose, nk'inyandiko, ibikorwa byakozwe n'umusaruro wawe, ni ayo wowe cyangwa abo mukorana mwanditse.
guide.limits.title: Ibyo idashobora gukora
guide.limits.model: Ibipimo by'ubushyuhe buri gihingwa gikeneye ni ibigereranyo byacu kandi ntibirageragerezwa mu murima. Bikoreshe nk'ubuyobozi, ariko wizere ibyo ubona mu murima wawe.
guide.limits.maturity: Kwera hakurikijwe ubushyuhe bivuga ko ikirere kigaragaza ko igihingwa cyagombye kuba cyeze. Ariko ni wowe wenyine uzi niba koko cyeze.
guide.limits.translation: Ubu buhinduzi bwakozwe na AI. Bugomba kuba bworoshye kumva, ariko nta muntu usanzwe avuga buri rurimi wabusuzumye bwose.
guide.limits.demo: Iyi demo ikoreshwa na bose, ntukayandikemo amakuru yawe bwite.
dashboard.picker.heading: Ni uwuhe murima ushaka kureba uyu munsi?
dashboard.picker.empty: Nta mirima irimo. Koresha seed script kugira ngo uyongeremo.
dashboard.stat.maturityHint: Byeze hakurikijwe ubushyuhe cyangwa bikeneye gusuzumwa
